title: Entitlement summaries with plan, seat owner, role, quota snapshot age, and local-only continuation
summary: Frozen entitlement summaries for the managed lanes. Each summary names the plan, role, seat owner, org/tenant scope, entitlement label, and quota-snapshot age, carries a non-empty local-only continuation note, and degrades seat loss and expiry to an explicit managed-blocked state rather than a generic sign-in error.

summaries.title: Signed in
summaries.summary: A team plan is signed in and active; managed actions are admissible within seat, plan, policy, org, and provider posture.
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, and Git continue regardless of managed state.
Direct and bring-your-own-key AI routes stay available.
summaries.required_disclosure: Render the signed-in account scope, plan tier, role, and seat owner; never imply the whole product depends on it.
summaries.recovery_cue: No action needed; managed actions are admissible.

summaries.title: Local only
summaries.summary: No managed account is signed in; the local core is fully usable and managed actions do not apply.
local_only_continuation: Opening, editing, saving, searching, local Git, and local automation all continue.
Sign in only to add managed lanes; nothing local depends on it.
summaries.required_disclosure: Render the local-only posture and never show a managed quota or spend number.
summaries.recovery_cue: Sign in to a managed account to enable managed actions; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Reauthentication required
summaries.summary: A managed reauthentication is required (signer rotation or attestation pending); managed actions pause until reauth completes.
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, and Git continue while reauth is pending.
Cached entitlement keeps managed reads available where policy allows.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Starting new managed-broker work until reauthentication completes.
summaries.required_disclosure: Name reauthentication as the reason; never collapse it into a generic account error, a seat loss, or a managed block.
summaries.recovery_cue: Reauthenticate to resume managed actions; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Managed blocked
summaries.summary: Managed actions are blocked by an admin or policy hold; the entitlement has expired and the local core remains usable.
summaries.entitlement_label: Team plan — expired and blocked by policy
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, Git, and existing local automation continue.
Bounded usage and offboarding exports stay available.
blocked_managed_only_actions: New managed-broker, relay, and remote-workspace actions while the hold is in place.
summaries.required_disclosure: Cite the policy origin and the expired entitlement; render an explicit managed-blocked state, never a generic sign-in error.
summaries.recovery_cue: Review the account or policy hold to restore managed actions; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Grace period
summaries.summary: A typed grace window is open; managed actions are admissible per the window and bounded artifacts can be exported before suspension.
local_only_continuation: Local settings and files stay authoritative on device.
Editing continues offline; sync resumes when the lane clears.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Pushing new managed work once the grace window closes.
summaries.required_disclosure: Render the grace-window close time and the export-before-suspend path; never show grace as a hard block.
summaries.recovery_cue: Export bounded artifacts before the grace window closes; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Seat removed
summaries.summary: This seat was removed, reclaimed, or deprovisioned; managed actions for the seat are explicitly blocked while local work continues.
summaries.entitlement_label: Team plan — seat removed by admin
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, Git, and existing local automation continue.
Local and offboarding exports stay available for the removed seat.
blocked_managed_only_actions: All managed-broker, relay, and remote-workspace actions for this seat.
summaries.required_disclosure: Cite the seat as the origin and render an explicit managed-blocked state; never collapse a seat loss into an org switch, a sign-in error, or a generic account error.
summaries.recovery_cue: Ask an admin to restore the seat to resume managed actions; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Plan downgrade
summaries.summary: The plan was downgraded; managed actions narrow to the plan floor for the remainder of the term.
summaries.entitlement_label: Individual plan — narrowed to the plan floor
local_only_continuation: Installed extensions and local or sideloaded packages keep running.
Local editing, search, and Git are unaffected by the plan floor.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Managed actions above the new plan floor for the rest of the term.
summaries.required_disclosure: Cite the plan as the origin and name the plan-floor narrowing; never show it as a full block.
summaries.recovery_cue: Managed actions are on the plan floor; upgrade the plan to widen them. Local work continues now.

summaries.title: Org switched
summaries.summary: The account or org was switched or transferred; managed scope is rebinding and the prior org's continuation is local-only for the transferor.
summaries.entitlement_label: Team plan — rebinding to a new org
local_only_continuation: Local checkout, editing, tasks, and Git continue while scope rebinds.
The prior org's local work stays available to the transferor.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Managed actions against the prior org until the new org scope is confirmed.
summaries.required_disclosure: Cite the org switch and what migrates versus what stays local; never collapse it into a seat loss or a generic account error.
summaries.recovery_cue: Managed scope is rebinding to the new org; local work continues now.

summaries.title: Forecast threshold
summaries.summary: A metered family is approaching or crossed its forecast threshold; managed actions stay admissible with a budget warning.
summaries.entitlement_label: Enterprise plan — approaching the budget threshold
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, and Git continue regardless of the budget warning.
Direct and bring-your-own-key AI routes stay available.
blocked_managed_only_actions: New managed-broker inference once the budget is exhausted.
summaries.required_disclosure: Render the forecast with its unit, as-of time, and scope owner; never show a forecast under an unauthoritative state.
summaries.recovery_cue: Usage is approaching the budget; raise the budget or wait for the window reset. Local work continues now.

summaries.title: Meter stale
summaries.summary: The meter or rating data is stale; the managed number cannot be confirmed now and is labeled stale rather than shown live.
local_only_continuation: Local editing, search, and Git are never blocked by a stale metering path.
Managed reads continue against the last confirmed snapshot, labeled stale.
blocked_managed_only_actions: Confirming a fresh managed number until the meter refreshes.
summaries.required_disclosure: Label the number stale with its last as-of time; never block local editing, search, or Git on a stale meter.
summaries.recovery_cue: The metered number is stale and labeled; managed actions resume when the meter refreshes. Local work continues now.

surface_bindings.summary: The account and seat usage surface renders each summary's plan tier, role, seat owner, org/tenant scope, entitlement label, quota snapshot age, and local-only continuation.
Diagnostics and service-health surfaces project the managed state, posture origin, and snapshot freshness without inventing a stronger claim.
Support and admin export packets carry the entitlement label, posture origin, degradation kind, and the local-only continuation notes for each state.
The Help/About truth surface names the current managed state, the local-only continuation, and that the local core never depends on a managed lane.
Managed-feature entry points show the explicit managed-blocked or narrowed state, the recovery cue, and what continues locally — never a generic sign-in error.
